coverage.invariant: everything a filmed click does to the page (it dispatches events and it gives focus) goes to an element that is under the pointer in the same turn, immediately before, and is the ref's node or inside it (vendor/cua-driver/PROVENANCE.md, Filmed delivery)
coverage.sequence: tests/test_filmed_click_invariant.py: 1178 cells = boundary x disturbance x start x press x where the nearest focusable element of the pressed one is (the control, the pressed element, a container of the control, nowhere). Per cell: the receipt and events equal the oracle's; the stand-in page, judging the focus by the same whole check as an event, saw nothing go to an element not under the pointer or not in the node; the unfilmed sequence sent what the source with the step's patch reversed sends.
coverage.calls: the same file reads the text of every page function a filmed action runs (the click sequence, the insert, the locate read, the connected check, the click's readback) and requires every method call in it to be named as one that reads or one that acts, each acting call made once in the statement that checks its receiver, with no property assignment and no computed call; and requires those five to be every function text the driver defines apart from four the filmed routes do not reach.
coverage.reporting: tests/test_filmed_outcome_reporting.py: the 27 rows of the eighth round, and one completed click with something to say (its press gave no focus), from the driver's text to the command's 'filmed take:' line.
coverage.page_log: tests/test_probe_filmed_page_pointer.py: each record's time is an interval from its own post and the records around it; an action record must be placed within 20 ms and lie wholly inside one step; the samples must hold over the whole interval; the log must be whole through a fence the page made because the probe asked for it after the last step's interval closed.
